response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, st.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval), t AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), r AS (SELECT t.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rnk FROM t) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressratio, scan_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction between 0 and 1 (group scan count divided by total matched scans), not multiplied by 100.
The top-10 cutoff uses RANK() over share, so every group tied with the 10th-ranked share is kept.
A site whose riskeval is NULL forms its own group, and its scans still count as matched scans.
